name: Just Natsuki
source:
An After-Story style mod for Natsuki from DDLC, focusing on building a post-game relationship between Natsuki and her player (you!).

[From the [url=https://github.com/Just-Natsuki-Team/NatsukiModDev]fan game page on GitHub[/url]]
translation:
一款以《心跳文学部》的夏树为主角、采用后日谈形式的模组，着重描写游戏结束后，夏树与她的玩家——也就是你——逐渐建立的关系。

[摘自[url=https://github.com/Just-Natsuki-Team/NatsukiModDev]GitHub上的同人游戏页面[/url]]
